statement_summary: Annual and new-contract risk assessment using SP 800-30
Security sanctions
Vendor and subcontractor security addendum and review before access
Section 889, Kaspersky, and FASCSA screening; quarterly SAM.gov check
Record retention and transfer at contract end
Contingency plan with manual-mode procedures; quarterly restore tests
Ticketed changes; OT hardening baseline; no default credentials
Patch within 30 days (14 for critical internet-facing); endpoint protection
Named accounts; shared device passwords in the vault
MFA for email, CMMS, cloud, admin portals, and remote access
Remote access to OT only through the jump host with approval and recording
Same-day access removal; PIV card return on the last day
Monthly administrator and quarterly access reviews
Change default passwords before connecting any device
Log and weekly review of sign-ins, admin actions, and remote sessions
Report suspected incidents within 1 hour
Put buildings in a safe state first
Customer notice within 24 hours (state, county) or immediately (GSA)
Annual tabletop with each customer
CUI marking, restricted storage, encrypted transfer
Security system plans handled as Restricted (exempt records)
Wipe or destroy media; shred at site offices
Isolated immutable backups; central controller program repository
Role-based OT, administrator, and CUI training
Call-back verification before granting remote access
Approved AI tools only; no AI or biometric features without P10 approval
